Flag aggregated CTAS scores

Flag_CTAS.Rd

Thin wrapper around gsm.core::Flag() that fixes the flagging to be one-sided. CTAS reports an unsigned -log10(p): it says "this site differs from the others", not in which direction. Signed flags would therefore be fabricated, so only 0 / 1 / 2 are emitted and no negative flag is ever produced in v1.

Usage

Flag_CTAS(dfAnalyzed, vThreshold = c(0.842, 2.326), strColumn = "Score")

Arguments

dfAnalyzed

data.frame Result of Summarize_CTAS().

vThreshold

numeric Ascending thresholds on the Score scale. Defaults to c(0.842, 2.326), drawn from experience.

strColumn

character Column to flag on.

Value

dfAnalyzed with an added Flag column, sorted by flag severity.

Details

Groups with Score = NA (no evaluated timeseries for the feature) keep Flag = NA; they are shown as not evaluated rather than as not flagged.

Examples

dfAnalyzed <- data.frame(
  GroupID = c("001", "002", "003"),
  GroupLevel = "Site",
  Numerator = c(1, 0, 0),
  Denominator = c(2, 2, 0),
  Metric = c(0.5, 0, NA),
  Score = c(3.1, 0.2, NA)
)
Flag_CTAS(dfAnalyzed)
#> ℹ Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 2.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 1.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 0.
#>   GroupID GroupLevel Numerator Denominator Metric Score Flag
#> 1     001       Site         1           2    0.5   3.1    2
#> 2     002       Site         0           2    0.0   0.2    0
#> 3     003       Site         0           0     NA    NA   NA
